mapper.select: SELECT b.booth_id, a.fair_id, b.business_id FROM booth b JOIN application a ON a.application_id = b.application_id WHERE b.booth_id = #{boothId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booth_feedbacks (review_id, booth_id, fair_id, business_id, user_id, purchase_behavior, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{boothId}, #{fairId}, #{businessId}, #{userId}, #{purchaseBehavior}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
